entities.name: Ralph de Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ralph de Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford, 2nd Baron Stafford, KG, of Stafford Castle and Madeley Castle in Staffordshire, was an English nobleman and a notable soldier during the Hundred Years' War against France.
